EXP-20.notes:
Beta 5: #5 Express session refused when a cart line is below zero 
Beta 6: PASS

Steps to reproduce:
Live mode, block checkout, Express wallets enabled.
Activate the QA helper plugin Negative Line Item (attached), which sets the cart line of Simple Product 0.02 to -0.02.
Add Simple Product 0.02EUR and Simple Product 1.00EUR to the cart (total 0.99 EUR).
Open the checkout as a customer with a saved address.

Actual result: POST /wp-json/mollie/v1/express/session answers 502 session_refused, no wallets are shown and an empty "Express Checkout" frame stays. Log: mollie.called POST sessions refused, express.session.failed kind: validation.

Expected result: the wallets are shown for a total of 0.99 EUR.

EXP-29.notes:
Beta 5: #6 Empty Express Checkout frame stays when the component cannot load
Beta 6: still fails for some cases

Steps to reproduce:
Live mode, block checkout, Express wallets enabled.
Guest, add Mollie Virtual Not Downloadable Test Product to the cart, open checkout.
Change the quantity about 10 times in a short time (session limit).

Actual result: POST /wp-json/mollie/v1/express/session answers 429 budget_exhausted, the wallet buttons disappear, but an empty "Express Checkout" frame with "Or continue below" stays on the page. Same frame stays when the session is refused (502 session_refused, see the negative line issue).

Expected result: the Express Checkout area is removed completely, as it is for a zero total or a physical cart without address.

EXP-30.notes: PASS (full idle cycle). Run by Claude (headless guest, live-mode site, taxes off, 1 x Mollie Virtual Not Downloadable Test Product). Session 16:01:58 UTC (200). Buttons visible at 5 to 25 min idle; at 16:16:29 (about 14.5 min) the component replaced the session once by itself (200). At 30 and 35 min idle the buttons are hidden (idle phase after the replacement session ran out), no error text. Interaction at 16:37:05 (mouse move, key, focus): new express/session call at 16:37:09 (200), buttons back (Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal), no JS errors. UI note: during the idle phase the empty "Express Checkout" frame with "Or continue below" stays (same UI issue as the session limit / session refused / empty required field). Earlier 20 min run 2026-10-20: buttons stayed visible after 20 min. Not covered: starting a payment after the long stay. Evidence: docs/e2e/manual/evidence/2026-10-21-exp30-idle35.png, 2026-10-21-exp30-after-idle.png.

EXP-31.notes:
Beta 5: Wrong or missing error message when the shopper logs-in in another tab during express checkout
Beta 6: PASS

Steps to reproduce:
Live mode, block checkout, Express wallets enabled.
Guest, add Mollie Virtual Not Downloadable Test Product to the cart, open checkout (tab 1).
In tab 2 log in as a customer.
In tab 1, without reload, click Google Pay or PayPal and approve.

Actual result: POST /wp-json/mollie/v1/express/order answers 403 rest_cookie_invalid_nonce "Cookie check failed". Google Pay shows the raw text "Cookie check failed" above the buttons and "Payment failed". PayPal shows no message at all. No payment is made.

Expected result: the message "Express checkout could not be started. Please reload the page and try again." for both wallets.
